CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION authorization_private.allowed(b uuid, e text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(not coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,true)
 and e in ('preview','live') and b::text=(nullif(current_setting('request.headers',true),'')::jsonb->>'x-faraios-business')
 and e=(nullif(current_setting('request.headers',true),'')::jsonb->>'x-faraios-environment')
 and exists(select 1 from public.business_memberships m join public.businesses x on x.id=m.business_id
 where m.business_id=b and m.environment=e and m.user_id=auth.uid() and m.active and m.role='owner' and x.owner_id=m.user_id),false)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION authorization_private.assigned(b uuid, e text, booking uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from authorization_private.worker_identities w join public.business_staff s on s.id=w.staff_id and s.business_id=w.business_id and s.environment=w.environment and s.active
 join public.business_booking_staff a on a.staff_id=w.staff_id and a.business_id=w.business_id and a.environment=w.environment
 where w.business_id=b and w.environment=e and w.user_id=auth.uid() and a.booking_id=booking)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION authorization_private.delegation_scope(b uuid, e text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from authorization_private.delegation_gate where enabled)
 and case e when 'preview' then exists(select 1 from authorization_private.preview_businesses where business_id=b)
 when 'live' then exists(select 1 from authorization_private.live_businesses where business_id=b and enabled)
 else false end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION authorization_private.member_role(b uuid, e text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select m.role from public.business_memberships m join public.businesses x on x.id=m.business_id
 where m.business_id=b and m.environment=e and m.user_id=auth.uid() and m.active
 and not coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,true)
 and b::text=(nullif(current_setting('request.headers',true),'')::jsonb->>'x-faraios-business')
 and e=(nullif(current_setting('request.headers',true),'')::jsonb->>'x-faraios-environment')
 and ((m.role='owner' and x.owner_id=m.user_id) or (m.role<>'owner' and authorization_private.delegation_scope(b,e)))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION authorization_private.owner_backfill()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 lock table public.businesses in share row exclusive mode;
 if exists(select 1 from public.business_memberships m join public.businesses b on b.id=m.business_id where m.user_id=b.owner_id and (m.role<>'owner' or not m.active)) then raise exception 'Conflicting owner membership';end if;
 insert into public.business_memberships(business_id,environment,user_id,role)
 select b.id,e,b.owner_id,'owner' from public.businesses b cross join unnest(array['preview','live']) e on conflict do nothing;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION authorization_private.protect_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$begin
 -- Serialize all membership changes for the business, including concurrent removals.
 perform 1 from public.businesses where id=old.business_id for update;
 if old.role='owner' and old.active then raise exception 'Accountable owner cannot be removed or changed';end if;
 if tg_op='DELETE' then return old;end if;return new;end$function$

 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER

begin

 end if;

end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.business_dashboard(p_business uuid, p_environment text, p_month date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare z text; today date; first_day date; next_day date; result jsonb;
begin
 select time_zone into z from public.businesses where id=p_business and owner_id=auth.uid() and not coalesce((auth.jwt()->>'is_anonymous')::boolean,true);
 if not found or p_environment is null or p_environment not in ('live','preview') then raise exception 'Dashboard unavailable';end if;
 today=(now() at time zone z)::date;
 first_day=date_trunc('month',coalesce(p_month,today))::date;
 if first_day<date '2000-01-01' or first_day>date '2099-12-01' then raise exception 'Choose a valid month';end if;
 next_day=(first_day+interval '1 month')::date;
 with bookings as materialized (
 select s.id,s.starts_at,s.duration_minutes,s.status,s.document->>'name' as name,s.assigned_staff
 from public.business_booking_schedule s where s.business_id=p_business and s.environment=p_environment and s.status<>'Cancelled'
 and s.starts_at < ((today+1)::timestamp at time zone z)
 and s.starts_at + s.duration_minutes*interval '1 minute' > (today::timestamp at time zone z)
 ), invoices as materialized (
 select i.id,i.number,i.document->>'name' as name,i.document->>'currency' as currency,i.status,i.due_on,i.balance
 from public.business_invoice_list i where i.business_id=p_business and i.environment=p_environment and i.state='Issued' and i.balance>0
 ), money as (
 select currency,0::bigint receipts,0::bigint reversals,0::bigint outstanding,0::bigint overdue
 from (select coalesce((select draft->>'currency' from public.business_service_catalogues where business_id=p_business and environment=p_environment),'ZAR') currency) c
 union all select currency,0,0,balance,case when due_on<today then balance else 0 end from invoices
 union all
 select i.document->>'currency',case when p.reversal_of is null then p.amount else 0 end,case when p.reversal_of is not null then p.amount else 0 end,0,0
 from public.business_invoice_payments p join public.business_invoices i on i.id=p.invoice_id and i.business_id=p.business_id and i.environment=p.environment
 where p.business_id=p_business and p.environment=p_environment and p.paid_on>=first_day and p.paid_on<next_day
 ), totals as (select currency,sum(receipts) receipts,sum(reversals) reversals,sum(receipts)-sum(reversals) net,sum(outstanding) outstanding,sum(overdue) overdue from money group by currency)
 select jsonb_build_object(
 'as_of',now(),'today',today,'zone',z,'month',first_day,'month_end',next_day-1,
 'bookings_count',(select count(*) from bookings),
 'bookings',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by starts_at,id) from (select * from bookings order by starts_at,id limit 8) t),'[]'::jsonb),
 'followups_due',(select count(*) from public.business_enquiries where business_id=p_business and environment=p_environment and status<>'Closed' and follow_up_on<=today),
 'new_enquiries',(select count(*) from public.business_enquiries where business_id=p_business and environment=p_environment and status='New'),
 'awaiting_quotes',(select count(*) from public.business_quotes where business_id=p_business and environment=p_environment and status='Sent' and expires_on>=today),
 'unpaid',(select count(*) from invoices where status='Unpaid'),
 'part_paid',(select count(*) from invoices where status='Part Paid'),
 'overdue_count',(select count(*) from invoices where due_on<today),
 'invoices',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by due_on,id) from (select * from invoices order by due_on,id limit 5) t),'[]'::jsonb),
 'money',(select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) order by currency) from totals t)
 ) into result;
 return result;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.business_service_image_valid(d jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if jsonb_typeof(d) is distinct from 'object' or (select count(*) from jsonb_object_keys(d))<>2 or not d ?& array['mime','data'] or jsonb_typeof(d->'mime') is distinct from 'string' or jsonb_typeof(d->'data') is distinct from 'string' or d->>'mime' not in ('image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp') or char_length(d->>'data') not between 4 and 200000 or d->>'data' !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$' then return false;end if;
 return octet_length(decode(d->>'data','base64')) between 1 and 150000;
exception when others then return false;
end$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.waitlist_ack(p_id uuid, p_lease uuid, p_outcome text, p_provider_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if p_outcome not in ('sent','retry','failed') then raise exception 'invalid outcome'; end if;
 update waitlist_private.outbox set
 status=case when p_outcome='retry' and attempts>=4 then 'failed' else p_outcome end,
 payload=case when p_outcome in ('sent','failed') or attempts>=4 then null else payload end,
 delivery_status=coalesce((select e.event_type from waitlist_private.delivery_events e where e.provider_id=p_provider_id order by e.received_at desc limit 1),delivery_status),
 provider_id=coalesce(p_provider_id,provider_id),sent_at=case when p_outcome='sent' then now() else sent_at end,
 next_attempt=now()+make_interval(secs=>least(3600,60*(2^attempts)::integer)),
 last_error=case when p_outcome='sent' then null else 'Email provider handoff failed' end,lease=null
 where id=p_id and lease=p_lease and status='sending';
 if not found then return false; end if;
 update public.waitlist_subscribers set status='suppressed',confirm_hash=null,confirm_expires=null where status<>'withdrawn' and id in (select o.subscriber_id from waitlist_private.outbox o where o.id=p_id and o.kind='confirmation' and exists(select 1 from waitlist_private.delivery_events e where e.provider_id=p_provider_id and e.event_type in ('email.bounced','email.complained','email.suppressed')));
 return true;
end $function$
